product.name: ALEX
product.introText: ALEX drawer unit, 36x58x70 cm, white, 5 drawers. Assembly instructions AA-2242840-5. Tools: flat and Phillips screwdriver, hammer. Work on a soft surface; do not use a power drill.
product.partsSummary: 1x Allen key,  1x Back,  1x Bottom,  34x Cam bolt,  18x Cam lock a,  16x Cam lock b,  5x Dback,  5x Dbottom,  16x Dowel,  5x Dside l,  5x Dside r,  5x Front,  4x Glide,  20x Nail,  2x Side,  10x Stop screw,  1x Top

steps.title: Cam bolts into the side panels
steps.text: Lay both side panels on a soft surface, runners up. Screw 3 cam bolts into the lower holes of each side panel by hand - do not use a power drill.

steps.title: Dowels
steps.text: Tap the wooden dowels into the ends of the bottom panel, into the top edges of both side panels and into the back panel.

steps.title: Side panels and bottom
steps.text: Stand the first side panel up, runners facing inwards. Push the bottom panel onto its dowels and cam bolts, then fit the second side panel onto the other end.

steps.title: Lock the bottom panel
steps.text: Put 6 cam locks into the bottom panel with the arrows pointing to the cam bolts, and turn them clockwise to lock.

steps.title: Cam bolts into top and back panels
steps.text: Screw 6 cam bolts into the top panel and 6 into the back panel.

steps.title: Fit the back and the top
steps.text: Push the back panel onto the rear edges of the side panels, then lower the top panel onto the dowels and cam bolts.

steps.title: Lock the top and the back
steps.text: Put 12 cam locks into the inside of the side panels and turn them clockwise to lock the top and the back panel.

steps.title: Glides
steps.text: Turn the unit upside down and press the 4 glides into the holes under the side panels.

steps.title: Large drawers: cam bolts
steps.text: Lay the 3 large drawer fronts face down. Screw the cam bolts into the inside of each front.

steps.title: Large drawers: sides
steps.text: Push the two drawer sides onto the cam bolts, grooves facing inwards.

steps.title: Large drawers: cam locks
steps.text: Put the small cam locks into the drawer sides and turn them clockwise.

steps.title: Large drawers: bottom
steps.text: Slide the drawer bottom into the grooves of the sides, smooth side up.

steps.title: Large drawers: back
steps.text: Slide the back panel into the grooves at the open end.

steps.title: Large drawers: nails
steps.text: Hammer 2 nails through each side into the back panel.

steps.title: Small drawers: dowels
steps.text: Tap a wooden dowel into the front end of each drawer side.

steps.title: Small drawers: cam bolts
steps.text: Lay the 2 small drawer fronts face down. Screw the cam bolts into the inside of each front.

steps.title: Small drawers: sides
steps.text: Push the two drawer sides onto the cam bolts, grooves facing inwards.

steps.title: Small drawers: cam locks
steps.text: Put the small cam locks into the drawer sides and turn them clockwise.

steps.title: Small drawers: bottom
steps.text: Slide the drawer bottom into the grooves of the sides, smooth side up.

steps.title: Small drawers: back
steps.text: Slide the back panel into the grooves at the open end.

steps.title: Small drawers: nails
steps.text: Hammer 2 nails through each side into the back panel.

steps.title: Drawer stops
steps.text: Screw a stop screw into the top edge of each drawer side, near the back. It keeps the drawer from being pulled out by accident.

steps.title: Insert the drawers
steps.text: Turn the unit upright. Slide the large drawers into the lower runners and the small drawers into the top two, then push them all the way in.
